sources.title: Changes in the macro and nano-structure of paper during moisture cycling
sources.version_or_release: Original research; published online 2023-12-20; Cellulose 31, 2743–2764 (2024); DOI 10.1007/s10570-023-05626-6.
sources.locator: Abstract; Background; Methods RH cycle at lines 109–127; Results lines 156–171.
sources.observed_operation: Directly opened article and reviewed abstract, methods, and results. Four commercial pulp types were used to make laboratory sheets; the RH cycle 50→20→90→50% at 23°C was repeated four times, with ≥24-hour holds; restrained and freely dried sheets differed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Laboratory sheet measurements only; initial transient and irreversible shrinkage depended on sheet preparation/restraint. The tested cycle is not a storage or label default.
sources.applicability: Supports conditional paper dimensional-change mechanism and separate dimensional endpoint; does not diagnose the case labels.

sources.title: Long term curl of printing paper due to ink solvent migration
sources.version_or_release: Published article version; Materials & Design 237 (2024), article 112593; DOI 10.1016/j.matdes.2023.112593.
sources.locator: PDF pp. 3–9; §§1.2–1.4, 2.1–2.2; especially discussion of curl and model liquid.
sources.observed_operation: Directly opened full PDF. It describes two office-paper grades, a 60 wt% glycerol/water model liquid, curl observations and glycerol-distribution work over one week, and proposes nonvolatile co-solvent migration as a mechanism.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Model ink/paper results; not a default for other printer technologies, label constructions, or this sleeve.
sources.applicability: Supports a conditional print/drying mechanism only if the actual process is relevant; does not establish the case printer or attachment failure.

sources.title: RXC Specification for Pressure Sensitive Adhesive Labels for Laser Printing
sources.version_or_release: October 2015 specification; labels for archival housings/storage furniture.
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1–3, §§ I–II, bond strength, print/readability, workmanship and QC.
sources.observed_operation: Directly opened NARA PDF. Confirmed paper face stock with acrylic adhesive for laser-printing use, permanent adhesive language, 90° peel test, separate print/readability and flatness properties, and explicit exclusion of direct application to documents or records.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Procurement requirements for specified housing/furniture applications and printer/toner; not a conservation-safety or sleeve-specific default.
sources.applicability: Useful system-level records and test-design example, not a product recommendation or case acceptance threshold.

sources.title: RXC Specification for Pressure Sensitive Adhesive Labels for Thermal Transfer Printers
sources.version_or_release: October 2015 revision; revision note says revised from May 2013 and reformatted September 2010.
sources.locator: PDF pp. 1–3, §§ I–II and QC table.
sources.observed_operation: Directly opened NARA PDF. Confirmed polyester or polypropylene face stock, acrylic adhesive, hard-resin ribbon compatibility, preference for polypropylene on curved substrates, and separate peel/print/flatness provisions.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Procurement specification for a stated thermal-transfer configuration and housing/furniture uses; not a default for unidentified materials or handwritten notes.
sources.applicability: Supports implementation-history questions and conditional system comparison only.

sources.title: Incorrect relative humidity
sources.creators: Canadian Conservation Institute, Government of Canada
sources.version_or_release: Current online guidance; no dated edition/version displayed.
sources.observed_operation: Directly opened current guidance. Confirmed RH is local and time-dependent, recording instruments near collections are useful, full-year observation may be needed for seasonal transmission in cases/cabinets, and existing damage does not alone establish current RH causation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Monitoring duration/locations depend on the question; full-year statement is for seasonal context, not label adhesive durability.
sources.applicability: Supports observation-first environmental monitoring and caution against unsupported climate changes; no RH record exists for this case.
